statement.zh: 莫斯塔盖达大英博物馆中埃及材料界定了塔西亚组合，见 Brunton 1937。塔西亚早于巴达里的相对排序若有争议则留假说栏。
statement.en: At Mostagedda, British Museum Middle Egypt expedition material defining the Tasian assemblage is documented in Brunton 1937. Relative ordering of Tasian before Badarian stays in the hypothesis column where contested.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only. | Substance tighten 2026-10-12: Tightened: Tasian assemblage first.
